newsitem.title: UK: BAA April traffic rises 6.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: BAA April traffic rises 6.0 pct.

text.p: British airport operator BAA Plc said on Wednesday that traffic at its airports in April rose 6.0 percent to about 8.05 million passengers.
Total cargo tonnage handled rose by 6.7 percent to 125,328 metric tonnes versus the year-ago period, the company said in a statement.
"This was a strong performance despite the effect of Easter falling in March," the company said.
BAA said passenger numbers at Heathrow airport rose 5.6 percent to 4.7 million, while Gatwick's traffic increased 4.7 percent to 1.9 million.
Heathrow's European-scheduled traffic grew 5.4 percent, boosted by diminished competition from Eurostar, BAA said.
Cargo at Heathrow rose 5.8 percent to 89,102 metric tonnes, while Gatwick posted a 5.7 percent rise to 23,674 metric tonnes.
